_why: EVERY Worker secret, declared once (owner lock 2026-10-01: 'everything from the pipeline'; 'portable, so in future we can update an API key'). One row per (worker, secret): the Cloudflare script it is set on, the vault key its value lives under in .claude/secrets.env, who sets it, what it is for, how to rotate it, and the code that reads it. NAMES ONLY: no value, no hash, no length ever lands here (tooling/ci/assert-worker-secrets-declared.mjs limb C).

Rotate a `replace: explicit` key: edit its vault key, then `node tooling/ops/worker-secrets.mjs sync --secret <SECRET> --replace <SECRET> [--worker <W>]` (a live name is never overwritten without `--replace <NAME>` spelled out). A `replace: never` key (TOKEN_ENC_KEY_*: it seals stored provider tokens) is NEVER overwritten while live, by any flag: rotate it as a new name (_V2) plus a re-seal migration (#1135 review finding 1). A `generated` key is made by `node tooling/ops/worker-secrets.mjs generate <SECRET> --worker <W>`, which refuses a name already live on the Worker, then writes the vault FIRST (custody), then PUTs. `node tooling/ops/worker-secrets.mjs check` diffs this file, the live secret NAMES and the vault NAMES.

`setBy`: `vault` rows are PUT by worker-secrets.mjs sync; `deploy` rows ride every deploy of deploy-workers.yml as --secrets-file from the GitHub Actions secret of the same name, so sync never writes them (a sync would be overwritten by the next deploy) and rotating one means the GitHub secret AND the vault key.

`kind`: `generated` (ours, random, `generate` makes it), `vendor` (issued by a vendor console: the owner mints it, the vault holds it), `config` (an out-of-band setting kept off the public repo: a heartbeat URL whose path is its credential, a flag, a host list).

`port`/`adapter`: the tooling/ports/.json registry and its adapter id the secret belongs to, so a vendor switch lists exactly the secrets to provision and to retire (`check --port

--adapter `). null/null for a secret no port carries yet.
`consumers`: the source files that READ the secret; each must exist and name it. A row whose consumer is only services/<w>/src/types.ts is a declared name no code reads yet.

rows.purpose: AES-GCM key v1 that seals stored provider refresh tokens (#1104).
rows.rotation: Never replace v1 in place: rows sealed under it would stop opening. Rotate by adding TOKEN_ENC_KEY_V2 (a new row, `generate`), re-sealing, then retiring v1.

rows.purpose: The sandbox Worker's own AES-GCM token key v1 (#1104 post-merge review, finding 5): a SEPARATE key from production's, so a sandbox row never opens with the production key and deploy-sandbox's health check is not refused.
rows.rotation: As production's: never replace v1 in place; add TOKEN_ENC_KEY_V2 for the sandbox with its own vault key, re-seal, retire v1.

rows.purpose: HMAC key native sign-in challenges are signed with.
rows.rotation: Replace the vault value (any 32 random bytes), then sync. Invalidates only challenges in flight.

rows.purpose: Google Cloud service-account key JSON for Play Integrity verdict decoding.
rows.rotation: Owner mints a new key in Google Cloud IAM, puts the JSON in the vault, syncs, then deletes the old key in IAM.

rows.purpose: Per-app signing-certificate SHA-256 digests a Play Integrity verdict must carry (public values, set out of band).
rows.rotation: Edit the vault JSON when a signing certificate changes (Play Console, App integrity), then sync.

rows.purpose: Apple Team ID whose App IDs an App Attest assertion must name.
rows.rotation: Changes only with the Apple developer account; edit the vault, then sync.

rows.purpose: Paddle webhook signature secret for POST /v1/money/paddle.
rows.rotation: Paddle dashboard: Developer tools, Notifications, rotate the destination secret; vault, then sync. Webhooks fail closed between the two steps.

rows.purpose: Paddle API key for checkout creation and subscription cancellation.
rows.rotation: Paddle dashboard: Developer tools, Authentication, create a new key; vault, sync, then revoke the old key.

rows.purpose: Razorpay API key id (declared for the razorpay adapter; no route reads it yet).
rows.rotation: Razorpay dashboard: Account settings, API keys, regenerate; vault (with the secret half), then sync both.

rows.purpose: Razorpay API key secret, the other half of RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.
rows.rotation: With RAZORPAY_KEY_ID: regenerate, vault, sync both.

rows.purpose: Razorpay webhook signing secret for POST /v1/money/razorpay.

rows.purpose: The fake payment rail's webhook HMAC key, for test harnesses only (#1127). SET ON NO DEPLOY: the fake serves `test` only, so /v1/money/fake answers 404 on every deployed environment.
rows.rotation: Never set it on a deployed Worker; a harness injects its own. A vault key under this name is a finding to delete, not a key to sync.

rows.purpose: App Store Server API key id for store receipt verification.

rows.purpose: App Store Server API private key (.p8 text) for store receipt verification.

rows.purpose: Play package name the Play receipt verifier queries.
rows.rotation: Changes only with the app id; edit the vault, then sync.

rows.rotation: Owner mints it from the Play service account; vault, then sync.

rows.rotation: Owner mints it from the Partner Center Entra app; vault, then sync.

rows.purpose: Apple Team ID signing the Sign in with Apple revocation client secret.
rows.rotation: Changes only with the developer account; edit the vault, then sync.

rows.rotation: AWS IAM: a new access key for the SES sender user; vault, sync both halves, deactivate the old key.

rows.purpose: Amazon SES secret access key, the other half of AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.
rows.rotation: With AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

rows.purpose: Box B's config-hash report secret (PB-27): POST /v1/ops/box-manifest admits a manifest for boxb only with it. The same value sits on Box B alone, in the root-only file tooling/ops/boxes/post-config-manifest.sh reads.
rows.rotation: Generate a new vault value, sync, then write the same value into Box B's root-only secret file (a box operation). Until both sides match, that box's posts are refused and the drift reader reports no row.

rows.purpose: Box C's config-hash report secret (PB-27): POST /v1/ops/box-manifest admits a manifest for boxc only with it. The same value sits on Box C alone, in the root-only file tooling/ops/boxes/post-config-manifest.sh reads.
rows.rotation: Generate a new vault value, sync, then write the same value into Box C's root-only secret file (a box operation). Until both sides match, that box's posts are refused and the drift reader reports no row.

rows.purpose: The ntfy topic URL the `ntfy` notifier posts owner alerts to (port-telemetry), the primary route. On Box B, so the `webhook` fallback covers its outage.
rows.rotation: Create the topic on the ntfy server, put its URL in the vault, then sync.

rows.purpose: Optional ntfy access token sent as a Bearer token with NTFY_ALERT_URL.
rows.rotation: ntfy server: issue a new access token for the alert user; vault, sync, revoke the old token.

rows.purpose: The OFF-BOX-B owner-alert endpoint the `webhook` notifier POSTs JSON to: the fallback that still reaches the owner when Box B (ntfy, GlitchTip, the vault) is down. The URL is the credential.
rows.rotation: Create a new endpoint off Box B, put its URL in the vault, sync, then retire the old endpoint.

rows.purpose: LEGACY HS256 fallback for the app API's auth; deliberately UNSET (ES256 through the JWKS is the path).
rows.rotation: Keep unset. Setting it re-opens the HS256 fallback; only with an ADR.
